page_subtitle: Learn every feature, who can use it, and the business rules behind it. Click "Usage" to open the feature and run a guided tour.
tour_admin_dashboard_s1_desc: At-a-glance counts: total/active/inactive businesses, users, and new sign-ups in the last 30 days.
tour_admin_dashboard_s2_desc: Growth trend, business-status mix, top industries, company sizes and user activity.
tour_dashboard_s1_desc: Switch between named dashboards. The + button adds a new tab (Manager+).
tour_dashboard_s2_desc: Add a widget, toggle the snap grid (Alt) and change zoom.
tour_dashboard_s3_desc: Drag and resize widgets freely; positions save automatically.
tour_datasheets_s1_desc: Download the Excel template, then import your file (simple / department / P&L).
tour_datasheets_s3_desc: Open a sheet to edit cells; rename, reimport, toggle status or delete from the row actions.
tour_departments_s1_desc: Owners create departments and sub-departments (max 3 levels).
tour_departments_s2_desc: Click a node to manage its members and manager; owners can drag to rearrange.
tour_my_business_s1_desc: Your business approval status. Pending/rejected limits access until approved.
tour_my_business_s2_desc: Edit KYB details. Editing an approved business creates a change request for admin review.
tour_profile_s1_desc: Update your name, avatar, language and bio.
tour_profile_s2_desc: Change your password and review active sessions.
tour_profile_s3_desc: The bell shows unread events; click to read and jump to the related page.
tour_onboarding_s1_desc: Fill the KYB form and create your business — it starts as Pending for admin review.
tour_admin_businesses_s1_desc: Switch between the businesses list and pending change requests.
tour_admin_businesses_s2_desc: Find businesses by name/owner and filter by status.
tour_admin_businesses_s3_desc: Open a row to review KYB and approve/reject/inactivate, or transfer ownership.
tour_admin_users_s1_desc: Find users by email/name and filter by active/disabled.
tour_admin_users_s2_desc: Open a row for details; enable/disable an account (disable revokes sessions).
tour_admin_audit_s1_desc: Filter the log by actor, action type and date range.
tour_admin_audit_s2_desc: Every admin action is recorded immutably here.
role_action_create_business: Create a business (up to 3 per owner)
lifecycle_pending_desc: Owner submits a new business — admins are notified. Only My Business + Profile are accessible.
lifecycle_approved_desc: Admin approves — full access. Later edits create a change request (admin re-approves).
lifecycle_rejected_desc: Admin rejects with a reason; owner must edit and resubmit.
lifecycle_resubmitted_desc: Owner amended a rejected business — awaiting re-review.
lifecycle_inactive_desc: Admin locks the business (reason required); members are blocked. Reversible.
lifecycle_note: Owner triggers create / resubmit / edit. Admin triggers approve / reject / inactivate / reactivate.
feat_signup_desc: 3-step wizard: account → 6-digit email OTP (15 min) → KYB business form. New business starts as Pending.
feat_login_desc: Email/password or Google sign-in; forgot/reset password. Disabled accounts cannot log in.
feat_onboarding_desc: Owners create a business with the KYB form (legal name, tax code, license). Up to 3 businesses per owner. Contact phone & email must be unique across all businesses.
feat_tabs_desc: Organize widgets into named tabs: create, rename, delete (cascades), reorder, colors & pin. Manager+ only.
feat_canvas_desc: Free-form 3200×4800 canvas with 20px snap grid, zoom 50–125% and collision detection. Everyone can view.
feat_widgets_desc: Add, drag and resize chart widgets; positions auto-save. Manager+ only.
feat_widget_settings_desc: Per-widget chart type (line/bar/area/doughnut), per-series type and dual Y-axis, colors and legend.
feat_datasheet_import_desc: Upload ≤10MB Excel (3 templates: simple / department / P&L). Background job parses rows→series; bad cells become 0.
feat_datasheet_list_desc: List, search, toggle status, rename, reimport (replaces data, keeps id) and delete. Everyone can view.
feat_datasheet_editor_desc: Edit cells inline; add/remove series and periods; export. Manager+ only.
feat_org_chart_desc: Department hierarchy (max 3 levels, no cycles; root = owner seat). Everyone can view; owner can drag.
feat_department_manage_desc: Create sub-departments, set managers (owner/manager only), can't delete root or parents with children. Owner only.
feat_members_desc: Invite by email + role (7-day code), add/transfer members between departments. Owner/Manager.
feat_personnel_management_desc: The Personnel page (/members) lets Owners & Managers manage every account in the business. Create accounts (Owner adds Managers/Staff, Manager adds Staff) → the system emails a set-password link (valid 24h) → the invitee activates then signs in. Edit info (name, phone) — reuses the Profile form; Owner edits Managers/Staff, Manager edits Staff only (never the Owner). Filter by name/email, role, status. Pending accounts: resend the invite email or delete. Active accounts: deactivate (signs out + blocks login) or reactivate. Status flow: pending → active ↔ inactive.
tour_members_s1_desc: Create an account for a staff member. The system emails a set-password link (valid 24h).
tour_members_s2_desc: Search by name/email and filter by role or account status.
tour_members_s3_desc: Edit info (name/phone); resend/delete pending accounts; deactivate or reactivate active accounts.
feat_profile_desc: Edit your name, avatar, language and bio. Name/phone are shared across your businesses.
feat_security_desc: Change password and review active sessions (log out one or all devices).
feat_notifications_desc: The bell shows unread count and business/approval events; mark one or all as read.
feat_switch_business_desc: Own or belong to up to 3 businesses. After login you pick which one to work in; open "Manage businesses" from Profile anytime to switch or register a new one (hidden once you reach 3).
feat_my_business_desc: View/edit business KYB. Editing an approved business creates a change request; a rejected one can be resubmitted. Contact phone & email stay unique across businesses. Owner only.
feat_approval_lifecycle_desc: Understand the Pending → Approved → Inactive states and what each means for access (see lifecycle above).
feat_admin_dashboard_desc: Platform KPIs (businesses, users, 30-day) plus charts: growth, status mix, industries, sizes, activity.
feat_admin_businesses_desc: Review KYB + license, approve/reject/inactivate/reactivate, handle change requests, transfer ownership.
feat_admin_users_desc: Search users, enable/disable accounts (disable revokes sessions), view membership details.
feat_admin_audit_desc: Immutable log of every admin action; filter by actor, action type and date range.
feat_benchmark_desc: Compare your metrics against industry benchmarks.
feat_talk_room_desc: In-app discussion space for your team.
feat_export_pdf_desc: Download dashboards as image or PDF.
feat_email_notifications_desc: Receive business/approval events by email (in-app bell already available).
feat_desktop_app_desc: Electron desktop client with offline sync.
feat_realtime_collab_desc: Live multi-user editing, plus mobile app and SSO.
